module: UI telemetry tracker. It tracks the screens (UI routes) the player opens and leaves: each screen is a `uiScreen` activity whose duration is the time spent on it, with the `from` field (origin screen) to reconstruct the path through the menus. Only route names are reported, never screen parameters. Depends on `telemetry_core`.
notes: The screen load time (`loadMs`, `loadToMount`) is attached at the end of the activity rather than being a separate event, to limit data volume (uiScreen is already the most frequent).
`loadEnterMs` and `loadReadyMs` are only added if the total load reaches `loadDetailMs` (250 ms).
A cancelled or expired navigation never calls onRouteTiming: that screen is reported without load time.
The code uses the modern hook onAfterRouteChange and not the old compatibility hook onUiChangedState.

dependencies.desc: Extensions to load before this one: `{'telemetry_core'}`.

onAfterRouteChange.desc: Hook called by the UI router once a navigation is finished: the displayed screen is then `entry.request.name`. Closes the previous screen's activity then opens `uiScreen` with `screen` and `from` (`entry.origin.route`). Without a screen name, does nothing.

entry.desc: Router navigation entry; fields read: `request.name` and `origin.route`.

onRouteTiming.desc: Hook called by the router after it has validated the route, so just after the activity is opened. Remembers the timings if the route matches the current screen; they are sent on close.

timings.desc: Navigation timings; fields read: total, mountAcked, enter, ready.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Hook called when the extension loads. Sets the extension to manual unload.

onExit.desc: Hook called when the game exits. Closes the open screen, otherwise the last one would have no duration.

onExtensionUnloaded.desc: Hook called when the extension is unloaded (a Lua reload does not go through onExit). Closes the open screen.
